Bug report (Neon Drift v1.3.2, Steam, Win11 23H2, RTX 4060 8GB, driver 566.14, 32GB RAM)
Steps: 1) Load Chrome Canyon, any car. 2) Pause mid-race. 3) Open Photo Mode. 4) Move the camera below the track.
Result: game freezes ~2 s then closes to desktop, no error window. Happens 10/10 times. Crash dump is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NeonDrift\Crashes, happy to send it. Didn't happen on 1.3.1.
PSA: do NOT quit while the spinning feather icon is on screen. I did and my save got corrupted. 11 hours gone. Devs pls add a warning

I don't usually write reviews, but Lumen Hollow deserves one. I played it over three rainy evenings with a cup of tea and it genuinely lowered my blood pressure. You're a tiny bird. You fish, you collect feathers, you help a grumpy old heron fix his roof. That's it, and that's enough. The watercolor art is gorgeous, the soundtrack is soft piano and rain, and there's no fail state anywhere: if you miss a fish, you just try again. I 100%'d it in about 9 hours and immediately started a second file just to hang out in the marsh at night. If you're burned out on games that want to be your second job, this is the antidote. Thank you, NEOINIT, whoever you are.

Quería que me gustara, de verdad. La estética es preciosa y la banda sonora está muy bien, pero:
1) La IA de los rivales hace rubber banding descarado: en la última vuelta te pasan como si tuvieran nitro infinito.
2) No se pueden reasignar los controles, y el drift en el gatillo izquierdo es incómodo.
3) De las 12 pistas, la mitad son la misma ciudad con otra paleta de colores.
4) El modo carrera se hace repetitivo antes de la mitad.
Por ahora no lo recomiendo. Si lo parchan, cambio la reseña.
